rules.statement: A person's cause of action for a prescriptive title does not accrue until their rights are interfered with or placed in jeopardy.
rules.supporting_quote: It cannot, I think, be said that any cause of action accrued until something had accrued which interfered with or placed in jeopardy his rights under that deed, and it is not contended that anything of that nature occurred before the property in question was included in the inventory.
